scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on their account and requesting a refund if unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Haruto Tanaka and I'm 85. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Hello, Mr. Tanaka. I would be happy to help you look into that charge today. To ensure your account security, could you please provide your account number and confirm your billing address?
Of course. My account number is 8829-4410-22, and I live at 124 Maple Street, Springfield.
Thank you for that information. I have verified your account. I see the $76 charge from 'Global Tech Solutions' on the 14th. Does that merchant name sound familiar to you at all?
No, that doesn't sound familiar. I don't use any tech services like that.

I understand. Under our Fraud Protection Policy, if a transaction is deemed unauthorized, we can initiate a dispute. I have reviewed the transaction details, and since this merchant is flagged as a high-risk category for unauthorized activity, I have successfully opened a formal dispute case for you, reference number #77291.
Oh, that's a relief. Does this mean I get my money back now?

Yes, Mr. Tanaka. Per our 'Instant Credit' policy for verified account holders, I have applied a provisional credit of $76 to your account, which you will see reflected within 24 hours while the investigation concludes. I have also blocked your current card and ordered a replacement to be sent to your home address to prevent any further unauthorized charges.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer, identified the unauthorized charge, opened a formal dispute, issued a provisional credit, and secured the account by replacing the compromised card.
